Functional Requirements.original_text:
- School Name with location
- Student ID
- Student Name
- Amount
- Transaction date
- Payment Remarks [value entered by the customer in the Remarks field in Fee Payment page]

Functional Requirements.requirement_text: SMS notification for EPP rejection due to insufficient balance shall be in a specific format with sufficient details.

Business Rules.requirement_text: The Student ID field and its re-entry field in any registration channel shall not allow copy-paste functionality.
Business Rules.original_text: Student ID field and the Re-enter field should not allow copy paste option.
Business Rules.source_section: STUDENT REGISTRATION / AMENDMENT / DEREGISTRATION VIA ONLINE BANKING / MOBILE BANKING

Business Rules.requirement_text: Student registration shall only be successful if the re-entered Student ID matches the initial Student ID.
Business Rules.original_text: Student registration should happen only if the Student ID entered twice matches correctly.
Business Rules.source_section: STUDENT REGISTRATION / AMENDMENT / DEREGISTRATION VIA ONLINE BANKING / MOBILE BANKING

Business Rules.requirement_text: Fee payment can only be initiated for students already registered by the customer.
Business Rules.original_text: Customer can initiate fee payment only for the registered students.

Business Rules.requirement_text: Each fee type against each student shall be an individual payment entry.
Business Rules.original_text: Each fee type against each student will be an individual entry.

Business Rules.requirement_text: Only active NGB credit cards shall be available for fee payment selection.
Business Rules.original_text: Only active credit cards should be available for the payment...

Business Rules.requirement_text: Payment shall only be allowed if the customer has sufficient available balance on the selected credit card.
Business Rules.original_text: Payment to be allowed only if customer has sufficient balance.

Business Rules.requirement_text: The Contact Center is responsible for verifying EPP transaction details forwarded to the Cards Center via E-Form.
Business Rules.original_text: Note: Contact Center will be responsible for the verification of EPP transaction details forwarded to Cards center thru E-Form.

Business Rules.requirement_text: Each payment amount shall be debited individually from the customer's credit card.
Business Rules.original_text: When customer initiates a payment, amount should be debited individually from the customer’s credit card...

Business Rules.requirement_text: Each payment amount shall be credited individually to the registered school's account.
Business Rules.original_text: ...and credited individually to the registered school’s account.

Business Rules.requirement_text: Transaction descriptions shall not exceed 40 characters.
Business Rules.original_text: Maximum length allowed for transaction description is 40 characters.

Business Rules.requirement_text: The AUTH code shall serve as the Unique Reference Number for transactions across all systems.
Business Rules.original_text: AUTH code will be used as Unique Reference Number across the systems.

Business Rules.requirement_text: Loyalty points shall not be granted for school fee payments that utilize the Easy Payment Plan (EPP) option.
Business Rules.original_text: Loyalty points will not be granted for the School Fee payment if EPP option is availed.

Business Rules.requirement_text: EPP conversion requests shall be rejected if sufficient balance is not available at the time of conversion (e.g., due to other payment settlement or auto debit).
Business Rules.original_text: If sufficient balance is not available during EPP conversion (due to other payment settlement or auto debit), the EPP request should be rejected...

Ambiguous or Subjective Requirements.requirement_text: The feasibility and cost of implementing a new IVR module (text-to-speech) to voice out student names needs to be checked by IT/vendor.
Ambiguous or Subjective Requirements.original_text: (The student name can be voiced out but will require to implement a new IVR module(text to speech) which requires to be checked for cost and feasibility from IT/vendor)
Ambiguous or Subjective Requirements.reason: This is an uncommitted feature that requires a separate feasibility/cost study. It is not a firm requirement yet.

Other_Observations.observation_text: The SRS describes a manual process for school registration data submission (Product team sending details in Excel format to Operations team) which is external to the system requirements but implicitly defines the data source for system registration.
Other_Observations.original_text: Product team should sent an approved email attaching necessary details for registration (mentioned above) in excel format to Operations team.

Other_Observations.observation_text: The SRS describes an operational procedure for Contact Center agents to check and verify the customer's RIM number (Line 043), implying the system needs to display this information to the agent but not perform the verification itself.
Other_Observations.original_text: Agent checks and verifies the RIM number of the customer.

Other_Observations.observation_text: Manual copying of RIM/Card number from IVR to E-Form by the agent is required (Line 045). This indicates a lack of direct system integration for this data transfer, which could lead to errors or inefficiencies.
Other_Observations.original_text: The RIM Number or Card number available in IVR has to be copied manually by the agent to the E-Form.

Other_Observations.observation_text: The SRS describes an operational procedure for Contact Center agents to refer customers to the 'Fee Payment' IVR option (Line 050), implying system support for this handoff.
Other_Observations.original_text: Customer should have an option to proceed for Fee Payment on the same call and Contact Center agent should refer those reuqests to “Fee Payment” option in IVR.

Other_Observations.observation_text: Transaction description in Vision Plus for IVR payments will be generic ('MEMO POSTED CREDIT') (Line 096). This implies a need for a separate detailed transaction log or for specific descriptions to be passed from IVR/E-Form, impacting auditability/reconciliation unless handled.
Other_Observations.original_text: Please note that description of the transaction will not be available in Vision Plus. Transaction description will be like “MEMO POSTED CREDIT”).

Other_Observations.observation_text: Assumption: Schools registered for fee payment will already possess an NGB account number (Line 131). This implies a prerequisite for school onboarding not managed by this system.
Other_Observations.original_text: Schools register with NGB for school fee payment will have NGB account number.

Other_Observations.observation_text: Integration with school websites for fee information retrieval is explicitly out of scope (Line 135).
Other_Observations.original_text: Any integration to school’s website for Fee information retrieval is out of scope.

Other_Observations.observation_text: Integration with any other payment gateway is explicitly out of scope (Line 136).
Other_Observations.original_text: Any Integration to any other payment gateway is out of scope.
